canonical_project: CMC Hyperscale Data Center (Saigon Hi-Tech Park)
notes: CMC secured approval for a hyperscale data center at Saigon Hi-Tech Park: initial 30 MW scalable to 120 MW IT load, ~USD 250 million investment, construction slated to begin 2026; AI-as-a-service, cloud and big-data focus with an NVIDIA GH200 GPU farm.
